title: RngRange can invoke signed-overflow UB despite claiming well-defined integer math
detail: For spans near 2^32 the offset narrows to a negative int32; Lo plus it can underflow int32 — signed-overflow UB — and the narrowing itself is implementation-defined pre-C++20, contradicting the header's own well-definedness claim.
recommended_fix: Compute in 64 bits end-to-end: int64 result = (int64)Lo + (int64)((Draw*Span)>>32); return (int32_t)result; — one well-defined narrowing, result stays within [Lo,Hi].

title: engine.sh usage comment sources a nonexistent path
detail: The documented source path resolves to <repo>/lib/engine.sh (the /.. escapes scripts/), which does not exist; actual callers correctly use $ROOT/scripts/lib/engine.sh.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to source scripts/lib/engine.sh (drop the /..).

title: Step() is not idempotent for the current tick; duplicate-tick case untested
detail: Only backward ticks are ignored; re-calling Step at the current tick redraws the nonce and consumes RNG stream, so 'advance the sim to Tick' is non-idempotent, and no test covers the same-tick case.
recommended_fix: Guard with Tick <= State.Tick for idempotence, or document call-count sensitivity and add a same-tick Step test.

title: README quickstart contradicts its own installed-engine status
evidence:
+| Engine installed? | **Yes — UE 5.8.1 installed** (2026-08-20); the full 7-gate suite runs green incl. build + 8/8 automation tests + PPProbe + 3-way golden compare |
+scripts/local-ci.sh              # full suite (engine gates skip until UE 5.8 lands)
detail: The status table says UE 5.8.1 is installed and the full suite green; the quickstart in the same file still says gates skip 'until UE 5.8 lands' — stale text contradicts the claim.
recommended_fix: Update the quickstart comment: gates now run; skipping applies only when the engine is absent.
